title: Customers who have ordered through all three channels
prompt: Which customers have, at some point, placed an order through all three channels (web, app, and marketplace)?
referenceSql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(DISTINCT channel) = 3

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE channel IN ('web', 'app', 'marketplace') GROUP BY customer_id
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: The IN filter just keeps rows with any of the three channels (which is all of them, since those are the only channel values) — it never actually checks that a customer used all three, missing the HAVING count(DISTINCT channel) = 3 condition entirely.
